name: choice-extension-alternative-skipped
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.19 (ASN.1 unaligned PER): Input: Alt holds its first extension alternative (big INTEGER (0..65535) in the checking module) with 1000: bit 1, index 0 as a normally small number 0 000000, open type length 2, 03e8. Decode skips it, so neither probe.a nor probe.tag is set; encode finds no alt with content and writes the first alt: bit 0, index 0, and a absent, written as lb 0 in 2 bits (ruling 1). 127 bits, padded with 1 zero bits to 16 octets. Derived without an engine by a standalone X.691 reference program (Python standard library) and checked against two independent ASN.1 UPER codecs on the ASN.1 module in the pack header: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper; asn1tools checks y (INTEGER (-5..MAX)) only as a length and octets, because it encodes a semi-constrained integer as an unconstrained one, which X.691 does not.
